name: hot-keys-tuning
description: Unified keyboard productivity configuration system with Karabiner Elements, IdeaVim, and WebStorm integration

scripts.generate:docs: cd keyboard-config && source venv/bin/activate && python scripts/generate-docs.py
scripts.export:csv: cd keyboard-config && source venv/bin/activate && python scripts/export-csv.py
scripts.hooks:status: echo 'Project Hook Configuration:' && cat .claude/hooks/keyboard-config-hooks.json && echo '\nHook Logs:' && ls -la .claude/hooks/logs/*.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No logs yet' && echo '\nBackups:' && ls -la .claude/hooks/backups/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'No backups yet'
scripts.setup: cd keyboard-config && python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install PyYAML
scripts.webstorm:sync: echo 'Syncing WebStorm configuration from Library to project...' && cp -v "$HOME/Library/Application Support/JetBrains/WebStorm2025.2/keymaps/"*.xml configs/webstorm/keymaps/ && cp -v "$HOME/Library/Application Support/JetBrains/WebStorm2025.2/options/vim_settings"*.xml configs/webstorm/options/ && cp -v "$HOME/Library/Application Support/JetBrains/WebStorm2025.2/quicklists/"*.xml configs/webstorm/quicklists/ && echo '✅ WebStorm configuration synced successfully'
scripts.karabiner:sync: echo 'Syncing Karabiner configuration from ~/.config to project...' && cp -v "$HOME/.config/karabiner/karabiner.json" configs/karabiner/karabiner.json && echo '✅ Karabiner configuration synced successfully'
scripts.karabiner:push: echo 'Pushing Karabiner configuration from project to ~/.config...' && cp -v configs/karabiner/karabiner.json "$HOME/.config/karabiner/karabiner.json" && echo '✅ Karabiner configuration pushed successfully'

author: Artem Sorochynskyi <caelum29@gmail.com>
